programme.desc: Released in 1940, it represented Disney's boldest experiment to date, bringing to life his vision of blending animated imagery with classical music. What had begun as a vehicle to enhance Mickey Mouse's career blossomed into a full-blown feature that remains unique in the history of animation. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1940

programme.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
programme.desc: The Grimm fairy tale gets a Technicolor treatment in Disney's first animated feature. Jealous of Snow White's beauty, the wicked queen orders the murder of her innocent stepdaughter, but later discovers that Snow White is still alive and hiding in a cottage with seven friendly little miners. Disguising herself as a hag, the queen brings a poisoned apple to Snow White, who falls into a death-like sleep that can be broken only by a kiss from the prince. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1937

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: In a classic Disney animation, a fawn named Bambi joins his new friends, a young rabbit named Thumper and a skunk kit named Flower in happily exploring the woods. Bambi is captivated with a young doe named Faline, and he learns from his doting mother and his father -- the Great Prince of the Forest -- that besides the delights of the forest, there is danger in open meadows where hunters can see them. Though fear and tragedy touch Bambi's life, another spring brings renewal. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1942

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: With a wicked stepmother (Eleanor Audley) and two jealous stepsisters (Rhoda Williams, Lucille Bliss) who keep her enslaved and in rags, Cinderella (Ilene Woods) stands no chance of attending the royal ball. When her fairy godmother (Verna Felton) appears and magically transforms her reality into a dream come true, Cinderella enchants the handsome Prince Charming at the ball, but must face the wrath of her enraged stepmother and sisters when the spell wears off at midnight. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1950

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: Lewis Carroll's beloved fantasy tale is brought to life in this Disney animated classic. When Alice (Kathryn Beaumont), a restless young British girl, falls down a rabbit hole, she enters a magical world. There she encounters an odd assortment of characters, including the grinning Cheshire Cat (Sterling Holloway) and the goofy Mad Hatter (Ed Wynn). When Alice ends up in the court of the tyrannical Queen of Hearts (Verna Felton), she must stay on the ruler's good side -- or risk losing her head. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1951

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: Fearful that her ailing father will be drafted into the Chinese military, Mulan takes his spot -- though, as a girl living under a patriarchal regime, she is technically unqualified to serve. She cleverly impersonates a man and goes off to train with fellow recruits. Accompanied by her dragon, Mushu, she uses her smarts to help ward off a Hun invasion, falling in love with a dashing captain along the way. (Animated, Children, Musical) - 1998

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: When street rat Aladdin frees a genie from a lamp, he finds his wishes granted. However, he soon finds that the evil has other plans for the lamp -- and for Princess Jasmine. But can Aladdin save Princess Jasmine and his love for her after she sees that he isn't quite what he appears to be? (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In Disney's beguiling animated romp, rebellious 16-year-old mermaid Ariel (Jodi Benson) is fascinated with life on land. On one of her visits to the surface, which are forbidden by her controlling father, King Triton, she falls for a human prince. Determined to be with her new love, Ariel makes a dangerous deal with the sea witch Ursula (Pat Carroll) to become human for three days. But when plans go awry for the star-crossed lovers, the king must make the ultimate sacrifice for his daughter. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1989

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: An animated Disney adventure follows disfigured Quasimodo (Tom Hulce), the bell-ringer of Notre Dame Cathedral, who bides his time locked away in a tower. With only gargoyles to keep him company, Quasimodo longs to be with other people, leading to his chance encounter with the enchanting Gypsy Esmeralda (Demi Moore). When the beautiful young woman catches the attention of Quasimodo's guardian, sinister Frollo (Tony Jay), Quasimodo must help to keep her out of his clutches. (Animated, Children, Drama) - 1996

programme.title: Fantasia
programme.desc: Released in 1940, it represented Disney's boldest experiment to date, bringing to life his vision of blending animated imagery with classical music. What had begun as a vehicle to enhance Mickey Mouse's career blossomed into a full-blown feature that remains unique in the history of animation. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1940

programme.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
programme.desc: The Grimm fairy tale gets a Technicolor treatment in Disney's first animated feature. Jealous of Snow White's beauty, the wicked queen orders the murder of her innocent stepdaughter, but later discovers that Snow White is still alive and hiding in a cottage with seven friendly little miners. Disguising herself as a hag, the queen brings a poisoned apple to Snow White, who falls into a death-like sleep that can be broken only by a kiss from the prince. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1937

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: In a classic Disney animation, a fawn named Bambi joins his new friends, a young rabbit named Thumper and a skunk kit named Flower in happily exploring the woods. Bambi is captivated with a young doe named Faline, and he learns from his doting mother and his father -- the Great Prince of the Forest -- that besides the delights of the forest, there is danger in open meadows where hunters can see them. Though fear and tragedy touch Bambi's life, another spring brings renewal. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1942

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: With a wicked stepmother (Eleanor Audley) and two jealous stepsisters (Rhoda Williams, Lucille Bliss) who keep her enslaved and in rags, Cinderella (Ilene Woods) stands no chance of attending the royal ball. When her fairy godmother (Verna Felton) appears and magically transforms her reality into a dream come true, Cinderella enchants the handsome Prince Charming at the ball, but must face the wrath of her enraged stepmother and sisters when the spell wears off at midnight. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1950

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: Lewis Carroll's beloved fantasy tale is brought to life in this Disney animated classic. When Alice (Kathryn Beaumont), a restless young British girl, falls down a rabbit hole, she enters a magical world. There she encounters an odd assortment of characters, including the grinning Cheshire Cat (Sterling Holloway) and the goofy Mad Hatter (Ed Wynn). When Alice ends up in the court of the tyrannical Queen of Hearts (Verna Felton), she must stay on the ruler's good side -- or risk losing her head. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1951

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: Fearful that her ailing father will be drafted into the Chinese military, Mulan takes his spot -- though, as a girl living under a patriarchal regime, she is technically unqualified to serve. She cleverly impersonates a man and goes off to train with fellow recruits. Accompanied by her dragon, Mushu, she uses her smarts to help ward off a Hun invasion, falling in love with a dashing captain along the way. (Animated, Children, Musical) - 1998

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: When street rat Aladdin frees a genie from a lamp, he finds his wishes granted. However, he soon finds that the evil has other plans for the lamp -- and for Princess Jasmine. But can Aladdin save Princess Jasmine and his love for her after she sees that he isn't quite what he appears to be? (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In Disney's beguiling animated romp, rebellious 16-year-old mermaid Ariel (Jodi Benson) is fascinated with life on land. On one of her visits to the surface, which are forbidden by her controlling father, King Triton, she falls for a human prince. Determined to be with her new love, Ariel makes a dangerous deal with the sea witch Ursula (Pat Carroll) to become human for three days. But when plans go awry for the star-crossed lovers, the king must make the ultimate sacrifice for his daughter. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1989

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: An animated Disney adventure follows disfigured Quasimodo (Tom Hulce), the bell-ringer of Notre Dame Cathedral, who bides his time locked away in a tower. With only gargoyles to keep him company, Quasimodo longs to be with other people, leading to his chance encounter with the enchanting Gypsy Esmeralda (Demi Moore). When the beautiful young woman catches the attention of Quasimodo's guardian, sinister Frollo (Tony Jay), Quasimodo must help to keep her out of his clutches. (Animated, Children, Drama) - 1996

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: In this Disney animated tale, the orphaned Tarzan (Tony Goldwyn) grows up in the remote African wilderness, raised by the gentle gorilla Kala (Glenn Close). When a British expedition enters the jungle, Tarzan encounters the beautiful Jane (Minnie Driver) and recognizes that, like her, he's human. Falling in love with Jane, Tarzan is torn between embracing civilization and staying with his gorilla family, which becomes threatened by the ruthless hunter Clayton (Brian Blessed). (Animated, Children, Musical, Drama, Adventure) - 1999

What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2011

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch

His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2018

programme.title: Toy Story 3

programme.desc: The Star family gets trapped in the bathroom in 'The Commode Episode', then in 'Tying the Klop-Knot', Bunny and Cecil need to have another Klopnodian wedding. (S2, ep 6)

programme.desc: In 'Bubblestand' SpongeBob introduces his friends to the art of bubble blowing, and in 'Ripped Pants' SpongeBob tries to impress Sandy at Mussel Beach. (S1, ep 2)

programme.desc: Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times in 'Visiting Vikings', then in 'It's Too Late... With Plankton' Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies. (S4, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob shrinks the whole of Bikini Bottom in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV', and then in 'Doing Time', Mrs. Puff is sent to prison when SpongeBob crashes his boat.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Camp Master Krabs hires the Flying Dutchman to run the camp store in 'Boo Light Special', then in 'Lake Crashers', The campers have a demolition derby under Lake Yuckymuck. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob's favourite jellyfishing net goes missing in 'The Pink Purloiner', and then in 'Squid Wood', SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang around with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs is messing up Pearl's preparations in 'The Slumber Party', and then in 'Grooming Gary', SpongeBob gives Gary a makeover, so that he can enter him in a pet show. But Gary's not so keen.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The show finds an adorable new star in 'Patty-Poo', then in 'Swaptoberfest', the Star family swap identities. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick ventures inside Cecil to learn how the body works in 'To Dad and Back', then in 'Survivoring', Cecil takes his kids camping, but Squidina wants the drama of reality TV. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Great Patty Caper: SpongeBob, Patrick and Plankton solve a mystery on a runaway train.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and the world in 'Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!', and in 'Chum Fricassee', Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton!

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day in 'A Finful of Sand Dollars', then in 'Cretins of the Night', SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty ...
programme.desc: ..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts a time-travelling food show in 'Time to Eat', then in 'Cleaning House', while Bunny's in Klopnod, the Star home becomes a mess. (S2, ep 13)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante in 'Neighborhood Wash', then in 'A Fridge Too Far', Patrick, GrandPat, and Cecil want Bunny to honor their accomplishments on the fridge. (S5, ep 5)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward's house becomes infested with a mail-order flea circus in 'Under the Small Top', then in 'Squidward's Sick Daze', Squidward fakes being sick, but SpongeBob arrives to care for him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to catch a Moon Jelly in 'Mooned!', then in 'Hysterical History', Sandy learns some Bikini Bottom history. (S14, ep 8)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: A tiny futuristic city exacts revenge on Patrick in 'The Wrath of Shmandor', and then in 'There Goes The Neighbourhood', Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours. (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video in 'Safety Worst', then in 'De-Pat-ment Store', Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall. (S4, ep 10)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts an award ceremony in 'The Starry Awards', and then in 'Blorpsgiving', Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family. (S1, ep 23)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his society of dullards and doofuses in 'The Nitwitting', then in 'The Ballad of Filthy Muck', Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in trash.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob mistakes an escaped convict for his driving instructor in 'The Getaway', then in 'Lost and Found', when Mr. Krabs sends him searching for a missing toy, SpongeBob finds himself lost too!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob volunteers to babysit 'Sandy's Nutty Nieces', then in 'Insecurity Guards', SpongeBob and Patrick volunteer as guards at the museum, while Squidward attempts to hang his painting unnoticed.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When Squidward is hurt on the job, he threatens to sue Mr. Krabs in 'Accidents Will Happen', and in 'The Other Patty', Mr. Krabs and Plankton find a common enemy in the new 'Flabby Patty' restaurant.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward cleans up the city of Bikini Bottom with help from SpongeBob in 'Keep Bikini Bottom Beautiful', and then in 'A Pal for Gary', SpongeBob brings Gary a pet that terrorizes him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob is determined to find out everything there is to know about Vikings in 'Dear Vikings', and then in 'Ditchin', Patrick persuades SpongeBob to ditch class, but fun soon turns to guilt.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Pest Of The West: SpongeBob discovers that he was related to the great Western hero, SpongeBuck. Hired as the sheriff of Dead Eye Gulch, he must reclaim the town from no-good Dead Eye Plankton.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob finds out that Squidward has never tried a Krabby Patty in 'Just One Bite', and then in 'The Bully', SpongeBob is worried by a new pupil at boating school.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs loses SpongeBob to Plankton in a game of cards in 'Welcome to the Chum Bucket', and then in 'Frankendoodle', SpongeBob gets into a fight with a doodle of himself! (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Sandy is out of town for a few days so SpongeBob and Patrick are pet sitting for her in "Wormy", and then in "Patty Hype", SpongeBob invents a brand new culinary sensation! (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs opens the Krabbiest place on earth in 'Krabby Land', and in 'The Camping Episode', SpongeBob and Patrick decide to go camping - in the back yard.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob has trouble saying goodbye to the most perfect Krabby Patty he has ever cooked up in 'To Love A Patty', and then in 'Breath of Fresh Squidward', Squidward becomes the most jovial Squid ever!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob must find a new home for some unexpected guests in 'Pet Or Pests', and then in 'Komputer Overload', Plankton decides that he's had enough of Karen, and tries to replace her with a new model.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Sandy creates a new invention to avoid doing chores in 'Are You Smarter Than A Smart Cabin', and then in 'Deep Sea Despot', Squidward takes over as Camp Master. (S1, ep 22)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper. (S1, ep 14)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: There is a certain amount of confusion, right away, in 'You Don't Know Sponge', and in 'Tunnel of Glove', SpongeBob and Pearl get stuck in the Tunnel of Glove, a romantic river ride at Glove World.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick try to join the extreme sports team The Drasticals in 'Extreme Spots', and then in 'Squirrel Record', Sandy finds a book of world records and tries to break them all!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When SpongeBob cooks at home, Mr. Krabs' customers leave his restaurant in 'SpongeBob's Place', then in 'Plankton Gets the Boot', Plankton gets kicked out of the house.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Gary's new habit causes a night of stress in 'Un-Breaking and De-Entering', then in 'Swimmin' Holed', Narlene and Nobby's secret swimming hole is exposed. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The Dinghies travel to outer space in 'Hats Off to Space', then in 'In a Nut's Shell', After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: We visit a town where the laws of logic no longer apply in 'SpongeBob in Randomland', then in 'SpongeBob's Bad Habit', SpongeBob can't stop biting his nails, but he also can't figure out why!

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidina report the news in 'Nitwit Neighbourhood News', then in 'Mid-Season Finale', The Patrick Show presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: A fitness variety show shows Patrick how to exercise in 'Star-Robics', then in 'Who's the Dummy Now?', a family of dummies move into the Star home. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot in 'Mascot Mayhem', then in 'Putt Up or Shut Up', Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick loses the remote in the cushions, so journeys into the couch to find it in 'Lost in Couch', then in 'Pat-a-thon', Patrick hosts a telethon to raise money for snails who can't dance. (S1, ep 3)

programme.desc: After Patrick eats life-threatening chum, SpongeBob helps him with his 'Chum Bucket List', then in 'Big Baby Patrick', Patrick devolves back into a baby so he can keep his childhood toys. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick take Squidward 'Jellyfishing' and then in 'Plankton!' SpongeBob falls victim to one of Plankton's evil schemes. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show

Determined to be with her new love, Ariel makes a dangerous deal with the sea witch Ursula (Pat Carroll) to become human for three days. When the beautiful young woman catches the attention of Quasimodo's guardian, sinister Frollo (Tony Jay), Quasimodo must help to keep her out of his clutches. (Animated, Animation, Children, Drama, Family) - 1996-06-21
